title: Every CLI failure prints one JSON error envelope on one stream
description:
Found while building the Papyrus BiblicusRunner (AnthusAI/Papyrus#365). Biblicus CLI failures are inconsistent, so consumers cannot parse failures from one known place:
- extract url-text: extraction failures print a full UrlTextResponse with status failed on stdout (exit 1, cli.py around 1353 on main 537264d, built in url_text.py 156-180), while input failures (invalid_input_json, missing_source_uri) and an escaped UrlTextExtractionError print a {status, error} envelope on stderr (exit 2, cli.py around 1319-1352).
- validate_request raises ValueError for invalid request fields (api/_common.py 68-71); main() prints the bare message as plain text on stderr (exit 2, cli.py around 4562-4576). This affects every typed command.
- extract web-metadata prints {status, error} on stderr; summarize map-reduce and extract article-text print TransformResult with error on stdout (web_transform.py 337-380); context-pack build-blocks has no structured failure.
Decide one contract (specs first): which stream carries failure JSON, one envelope shape, and exit codes; apply it to every command that emits JSON. Coordinate the consumer change in Papyrus biblicus_runner.py (each typed method declares its failure stream today). Do after blbs-49f6fb lands, since it touches the split cli modules.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus/pull/82. Contract: every typed command prints one CommandFailure JSON object on stdout, stderr empty; exit 2 = rejected by validation (incl. invalid_configuration), exit 1 = operation failed; details keep url-text and transform diagnostics. Code-to-exit table is in docs/api-contract.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done 2026-10-19: PR 82 merged to develop. Typed commands (every API_COMMANDS entry) print exactly one CommandFailure on stdout on failure, {status: failed, error: {code, message, details}}, stderr empty; exit 2 for request rejection (invalid_request, invalid_input_json, missing_source_uri, missing_input, invalid_input, input_too_large, invalid_configuration), exit 1 for operation failures. url-text failures keep diagnostics in typed UrlTextFailureDetails, transform failures in TransformFailureDetails. Contract in docs/api-contract.md. Released as a fix (patch). Papyrus runner must change in lockstep: see the Papyrus follow-up.
